source.candidate_subject: feat: promote C512 FP8 QKV register feed

baseline_binary.route: canonical exact-C512 FP8 QKV whole-chunk M128 B-reuse kernel

candidate_binary.route: production exact-C512 FP8 QKV register-feed kernel with engine-lifetime GPU-packed sidecars

source.comparability: The candidate is the direct child of the frozen baseline. The production delta is the C512 QKV sidecar owner, GPU pack, model binding, dispatch selection, and the already-admitted register-feed compute kernel; C256 and Decode retain the baseline canonical route.

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Jetson AGX Orin, one pinned checkpoint, batch one, output one, direct native-runner timing

production_route.selected_kernel: M128-by-N128, 256 threads, 320 CTAs, three-stage raw A/B cp.async pipeline, decoded matrix-B register feed
canonical_route_retained_for: C512 with only 8-byte rather than 16-byte activation alignment
all non-QKV shapes and all unsupported or unrequested configurations
production_route.interpretation: This is a C512-only projection data-layout and kernel promotion. Prefill and Decode remain logically distinct host plans in the existing runner, but the request remains causally serial and this change adds no phase overlap or request buffering.

sidecar_lifecycle.ownership: one engine-lifetime contiguous arena declared before ModelWeights so reverse destruction retires runner, request state, and model views before the arena
sidecar_lifecycle.representation_policy: bounded dual residency: canonical QKV remains authoritative for validation, C256, finish-Prefill, and Decode; the lossless equal-byte fragment-native layout is optional and C512-only
sidecar_lifecycle.inventory: all 48 actual linear-attention layer indices are validated before allocation; layer indices are not assumed contiguous
sidecar_lifecycle.construction: one nonblocking startup stream launches one GPU pack per eligible layer, then synchronizes, destroys the stream, and atomically attaches the complete descriptor set
sidecar_lifecycle.admission: cudaMemGetInfo is checked before and after allocation against the configured 8-GiB minimum free-memory reserve
sidecar_lifecycle.fallback: an ineligible inventory, capacity miss, or CUDA allocation miss releases or avoids the complete arena and retains canonical production dispatch with an explicit load-stat fallback reason

nsight_gpu_pack.interpretation: The 28.090400-ms GPU sum is one engine-startup pack across 48 layers. It is not included in request Prefix or TTFT latency.

kernel_resources.source: release-binary cuobjdump resource usage plus the production checkpoint validation resource query

formal_protocol.comparison: arithmetic mean of mirrored per-process medians: B=(B1+B2)/2 and C=(C1+C2)/2
formal_protocol.prefix_definition: all prompt tokens except the final prompt token and LM head

formal_canonical_output_extraction.fields: prompt_ids, generated_ids, generated_text, stop_reason, step_count, steps

dispatch_gate.attached_C256: same canonical kernel as null-sidecar C256
dispatch_gate.attached_Decode_M1: same canonical kernel as null-sidecar M1
dispatch_gate.eight_byte_activation_alignment: preserves the canonical public C512 ABI

correctness.release_reference_e2e: pass: 19 prompt IDs, 26 generated IDs, exact text, im_end, and 44 steps with all 48 QKV sidecars enabled

bulk_e2e.P513: exact token 9419, text Hello, 513 steps, production C512 register-feed route

memory.assessment: The candidate adds one fixed-size engine-lifetime derived-weight arena and no request workspace. Both candidate formal processes keep more than 36.5 GB free at the logged minimum and report zero persistent drop. Capacity failure is a complete canonical fallback, not a partial sidecar state.

decode_non_regression.protocol: P19, C32, max26, one warmup, five measurements, prepared short-position Decode Graph cache
decode_non_regression.generated_text: CUDA 是 NVIDIA 开发的一种并行计算平台和编程模型，旨在利用 GPU 的强大算力来加速通用计算任务。
decode_non_regression.assessment: pass: Decode remains canonical and exact; the diagnostic candidate result is consistent with the frozen 105.870500-ms/token non-MTP regression anchor

nsight_p513_c512.protocol: matched frozen baseline and candidate Release binaries, one P513/output-one generation each, NVTX phase ranges enabled, no benchmark warmup; whole-process startup is captured so the pack row can be separated from request Prefix
nsight_p513_c512.interpretation: The 48-for-48 QKV substitution explains the matched isolated row improvement. Prefix node count is unchanged because this is a dataflow replacement, while the one-time pack is outside the request range. Formal mirrored logs, rather than these one-shot traces, are authoritative for end-to-end latency.

external_comparison.accounting: P divided by scheduled-to-first-token for stock vLLM and P divided by native TTFT for this candidate
external_comparison.stock_vllm_backend: FlashInfer for 16 full-attention layers, Triton/FLA GDN Prefill for 48 linear-attention layers, and Marlin FP8/NVFP4 projections
external_comparison.interpretation: This is a directional comparison between different runtime systems under matched batch-one/output-one accounting, not a same-kernel attribution. The production promotion narrows but does not close the remaining 2.155820x P513 gap.

full_ctest.skip_breakdown: one tokenizer plus eleven external-model/performance tests

decision.result: promote exact aligned C512 linear-attention FP8 QKV register feed
decision.why: The previously admitted real-checkpoint cell now passes production ownership, GPU-pack, dispatch, exact-output, model E2E, bounded-memory, Decode non-regression, mirrored fixed-clock Prefix/TTFT, full-suite, and matched Nsight gates. P513 Prefix improves 1.017792552x and the 48 QKV kernels improve 1.291122684x.
decision.retained_boundaries: C256 and Decode remain canonical; the sidecar is a bounded optional derived layout with an 8-GiB reserve and complete fallback; no MTP, FlashInfer integration, new double/triple buffering, or Prefill/Decode overlap is used.
next_priority: first screen one exact-C512 QKV P0 that consumes canonical row-major raw B through three cp.async slots, performs the fragment gather in shared memory, and feeds matrix-B registers without allocating another sidecar; enforce the frozen first-process stop-loss before NCU, full-model, or production work

only if that no-new-sidecar QKV P0 fails its stop-loss, extend the admitted sidecar mechanism in P513-hotspot order: linear-attention Z, then full-attention Q, then attention output, with an explicit cumulative engine-memory budget at each step
keep C256 register-feed work behind those P513 hotspots; C256 and Decode remain canonical until a later shape-specific gate
re-profile the resulting P513 Prefix and continue against the matched 411.385053-token/s stock-vLLM reference
continue the bounded OpenAI-compatible API and EvalScope alignment in parallel

limitations: The formal result is batch one, P513, max1, one pinned checkpoint, one Orin, fixed clocks, and mirrored process medians; it is not concurrent serving throughput, a latency tail, power, or energy result.
The 2.34375-GiB sidecar is deliberate bounded dual residency because canonical QKV is still required by C256 and Decode. This is not yet a single-resident representation.

B/C load.total_ms is not used for attribution because unrelated NVFP4 down-sidecar startup preparation differs materially between those processes. Only the named QKV prepare phase and matched Nsight pack row are attributed.
Only C512 QKV selects register feed. C256, finish-Prefill, Decode, every other projection shape, and alignment near misses retain canonical routes.
The matched stock-vLLM result is a different-system directional reference. Native P513 remains 2.155820x behind it.
No MTP, native FlashInfer dependency, continuous batching, double/triple buffering, independent phase executor, or Prefill/Decode overlap is introduced.
